E0060

Teaching: retired C FFI marker spelling → `#Extern` / `#Bindgen` (D-CFFI-SYNTAX-REOPEN, D-CFFI-CANON1)

What

Teaching: retired C FFI marker spelling → `#Extern` / `#Bindgen` (D-CFFI-SYNTAX-REOPEN, D-CFFI-CANON1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0060

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0060: tests/ui/cffi_retired_hash_extern.stderr.

Error [E0060]: C FFI modules use `#Extern`, not `#extern`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_retired_hash_extern.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | #extern module c.demo {
    | ^^^^^^^
 Why: C FFI rules use the one PascalCase `#Rule` family in generated and hand-written bindings
 Fix: write `#Extern` before `module c.<lib>`
